subject: Aligning demo window and infra + security introductions
thread_body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@medlytics.com>, Priya Kapoor <p.kapoor@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning demo window and infra + security introductions

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to hear more about MedLytics' dataflow and the latency targets you're aiming for. As discussed, next best step is a 60–75 minute technical deep dive where we can:
- Walk a short sandbox demo of Redwood running a 2-stage inference pipeline
- Validate SSO/SAML and VPC peering options you asked about
- Surface preliminary throughput / cost estimates for 1M daily tokens

I'm proposing a couple of candidate windows next week (all PT):
- Wed 8/11 09:00–10:15
- Thu 8/12 13:00–14:15
- Fri 8/13 11:00–12:15

I've looped in Marissa (solutions eng) who will run the demo. Before we lock a time, Priya mentioned involving infra/security — if you can confirm who from that team should join, I'll add them to the invite and include a short evidence packet (SOC2 summary + network checklist).

Attachments: demo-agenda-MedLytics.xlsx (outline), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level)

Next steps: pick one of the above windows or suggest 2 alternatives and share any special gating items for procurement/security we should prep.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@medlytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <p.kapoor@medlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window and infra + security introductions

Thanks Rafael — Wed 8/11 looks best for our team. Can you also include someone from platform/networking? Alex Soto (cc'd) will be our infra lead and needs to confirm firewall rules / peering options.

Two quick asks from our side before the deep dive:
1) Can you share the SOC2 summary you mentioned (pdf) and a one-page list of required firewall ports and outbound endpoints?
2) We'll likely want procurement to see expected cost ranges for both hosted and dedicated options; is a back-of-envelope per-token estimate available ahead of the call?

If Wed 8/11 is still OK, let's tentatively lock 09:00 PT and we'll confirm by EOD.

--

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@medlytics.com>, Priya Kapoor <p.kapoor@medlytics.com>, Alex Soto <alex.soto@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window and infra + security introductions

Perfect — locking Wed 8/11 09:00–10:15 PT as a provisional slot. Adding Marissa (will run demo), Tessa (security/compliance), and Vivek (platform) so we can answer infra and audit questions live.

Jordan / Alex — attaching the SOC2 one-pager and a short network checklist. For the firewall/endpoints:
- Outbound HTTPS to *.redwood-inference.com on 443 (for control plane calls)
- Optional: specific egress to inference endpoints that we can narrow per region (we'll share the CIDR list ahead of the call)
- If you plan private deployment: we support VPC peering and customer NAT — we'll add network diagrams to the drive link.

Back-of-envelope cost ranges (very approximate, will refine in follow-up):
- Hosted API: $0.0008–$0.0020 per generated token depending on model family and concurrency
- Dedicated (reserved): committed monthly starting ~$12k/month for a small pool; unit cost falls with utilization and quantization profiles

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, demo-agenda-MedLytics.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-materials
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Action items before the call:
- Rafael/Marissa: confirm demo plan and send calendar invite (sent after Alex confirms)
- Alex: confirm whether you prefer VPC peering or VPN tunnel for initial sandbox (reply with preference)
- Priya: any procurement folks we should add? If yes, pls provide name + email

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Rafael

--

From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@medlytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Jordan Miller <jmiller@medlytics.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <p.kapoor@medlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window and infra + security introductions

Thanks all — Wed 8/11 09:00 PT works for me. For the sandbox I'd prefer VPC peering to keep traffic in-region; we can evaluate VPN later if we need to.

Couple of clarifications:
- Please include the CIDR ranges for the inference endpoints before the call so my network team can pre-approve firewall rules.
- On procurement: I'll loop in our procurement lead (name/ email below) after this thread; Priya, can you confirm budget owner?

Procurement contact (tentative):
- Samir Rao <samir.rao@medlytics.com>

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Alex

----
Notes: calendar invite to be created by Rafael; Marissa will prepare a 15-minute sandbox demo + 25-minute Q&A and keep 20 minutes for procurement/security deep-dive.
